facts.value: Goethe University offers a diverse range of opportunities for international students, including semesters abroad, ERASMUS programs, internships, and research and teaching work.
Goethe University is globally connected and maintains a wide range of international university partnerships.
Goethe University's Internationalization is based on a collaboratively developed strategy that guides actions and university-wide development across all faculties.
Goethe University maintains partnerships with over 450 universities across Europe and around the world.
Goethe University promotes international exchange among students and international research, thereby strengthening global networking.
